mapper.sql: id, chat_group_id, topic_id, sender_id, sender_type, message_type, content, reply_to_message_id, feature, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (chat_group_id, topic_id, sender_id, sender_type, message_type, content, reply_to_message_id, feature, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{chatGroupId}, #{topicId}, #{senderId}, #{senderType}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{replyToMessageId}, #{feature, typeHandler=com.dingring.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE topic_id = #{topicId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE chat_group_id = #{groupId}
SELECT FROM message WHERE chat_group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
